name: Companions
description: Links movies and series to their soundtrack in your music library and to the book or audiobook in Audiobookshelf, Kavita, Grimmory or BookOrbit.
overview: Soundtracks, books and audiobooks for your movies

versions.changelog: Books: the English title is looked up through Jellyfin's TMDB provider and searched too (Atelier of Witch Hat -> Witch Hat Atelier); volume numbers are ignored when comparing titles; more than four volumes of one series on one server are shown as one card with the number of volumes.
Books: a book also matches through its book series (Silo -> Wool, Shift, Dust) in Audiobookshelf, Grimmory and BookOrbit; books of a series are listed in series order.

Books: titles are also searched without a leading number or article (3 Body Problem -> Body Problem), so book servers that search literally find The Three-Body Problem even when Jellyfin knows no source author.

Books: authors match in any name order (Liu Cixin = Cixin Liu), numbers match their words (3 Body Problem = The Three-Body Problem), and titles with a number are also searched with the number spelled out.

Audiobookshelf covers: falls back to the original image when resizing fails and accepts covers without a content type; failures are logged and shown by Explain. The book row is no longer a Jellyfin item row, so other plugins do not add their cards to it.
First release: soundtracks from the music library, books and audiobooks from Audiobookshelf, Kavita, Grimmory and BookOrbit
